test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some students are bright.

All bright people are successful.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some students are successful.

II. Some successful people are students.

III. All successful people are students.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
__Statements:__

Some students are bright.

All bright people are successful.

__Venn Diagram:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39bc22c72f465110f98f7ebc7c1c628ca157e64d338e06b1f8cffff1e7f3e876.png] 

__Conclusions:__

**I. Some students are successful **→ Follow →** **We are given that some students are bright and all bright are successful so there is a direct relation which can be seen that some students are successful. Thus the conclusion follows.

**II. Some successful people are students **→ Follow →** **We are given that some successful people are bright and some bright are students so it can be said that some successful people are students and therefore the conclusion follows.

**III. All successful people are students **→ Does not follow →** **According to the statements and the diagram it is clear that not all successful people are bright also not all bright people are students so it will be wrong to say that all successful people are students so the conclusion does not follow.

Since **both conclusions I and II follow.**

**Hence** **the correct answer is option 2.**
